faq_heading: Homes near R E Mountain Secondary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the R E Mountain Secondary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Langley School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the R E Mountain Secondary home search find homes?
faq.a: By name: a listing shows up when its description mentions R E Mountain Secondary. Ask Jared to watch for nearby homes that leave the school out.

faq.q: How much do homes near R E Mountain Secondary sell for?
faq.a: Within 2 km of the school, 1,140 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,490,000, townhomes $835,000, condos $569,900. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near R E Mountain Secondary?
faq.a: Within 2 km of R E Mountain Secondary the median was 22 days on the market, closing at 97.8% of the list price, with 5% of sales above the list price for the 1,140 homes within 2 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to R E Mountain Secondary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Peter Ewart Middle School (0.3 km north), Donna Gabriel Robins Elementary (0.8 km north-east) and R C Garnett Demonstration Elementary (1.1 km south).

R E Mountain Secondary is a secondary school in Langley (Langley School District), at 7633 202a St. It teaches grades 9 to 12. Programs listed: International Baccalaureate (district find-a-school tag).
Use the search below to see homes for sale that name R E Mountain Secondary in the listing, then check the sold prices within 2 km of the school.
How the R E Mountain Secondary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names R E Mountain Secondary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 2 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 2 km of R E Mountain Secondary sold for

Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 1,140 homes sold within 2 km of R E Mountain Secondary: 163 houses, 505 townhomes and 379 condos. The largest group was townhomes, at a median of $835,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of R E Mountain Secondary
